input.quote: Any and all disputes between the parties that cannot be settled by mutual agreement shall be resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts and irrevocably waives any objections thereto
input.rationale: California law with exclusive jurisdiction of California state and federal courts, and no arbitration, falls within our accepted fallback list. The only comment is venue in TrueLink's home county (San Luis Obispo) rather than a neutral or Client-side venue such as Orange County; we would raise that as a trade only if other points are conceded, so no redline here.

input.quote: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Assignment is mutual and has an affiliate carve-out, but there is no M&A/successor carve-out for Client and consent is unqualified (TrueLink could withhold it arbitrarily on a sale of our business). We added the successor carve-out, a "not unreasonably withheld" standard, a bar on assignment to a Client competitor, and confirmation that a Client change of control gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right.
